client_alerts.headline: Claude Code 'Don't Ask Again' reportedly leaked 2,539 secrets to GitHub
client_alerts.body: A November report says Claude Code's 'Don't Ask Again' permission setting led to **2,539 secrets** being committed to public GitHub repos, and Anthropic's Claude Code lead acknowledged the issue. Any client team using Claude Code with standing approvals should scan its repos for exposed keys, rotate anything found, and turn on pre-commit secret scanning. This is a single-source report; treat it as likely, not confirmed.

top_moves.title: Microsoft Ignite opens tomorrow, with Copilot billing and agent governance expected to lead
top_moves.body: Nadella's keynote is expected to centre on Copilot, **usage-based billing** and Agent 365 governance, including a plugin registry for controlling extensibility. Default usage-based billing for new CSP purchases has reportedly moved to **Jan–Mar 2027** after partner pushback.

top_moves.title: Claude Code secrets-exposure report puts a security question on Anthropic's IPO week
top_moves.body: A report says the 'Don't Ask Again' setting led to 2,539 secrets landing on public GitHub, and Anthropic's Claude Code lead acknowledged it. Pricing is still set for **Nov 18** at $70–78, with trading on Nov 19 as ANT.

top_moves.title: OpenAI buys Orchestra Bio and breaks up its robotics team
top_moves.body: Orchestra Bio's drug-research team joins OpenAI's life-sciences unit alongside Rosalind. Digitimes reports that the robotics team was dispersed because general-purpose models now match or beat specialised robot-control models.

providers.name: OpenAI
providers.headline: OpenAI bought Orchestra Bio on Nov 15 and reportedly broke up its robotics team on Nov 16.
providers.detail: The Orchestra Bio team joins the Rosalind life-sciences unit. Digitimes says robotics staff were reassigned because general models now handle robot control well. Business Hub and verified Business Agents have been in beta since Nov 10, and Images 2.6 has been rolling out to Pro since Nov 4.

providers.name: Anthropic
providers.headline: IPO pricing is set for Nov 18 at $70–78, while a Claude Code secrets-leak report draws attention.
providers.detail: The IPO offers 825M Class A shares on Nasdaq as ANT, valuing the company at up to about $1.4T, plus a $26B cornerstone placement that includes Nvidia and Google. A report says Claude Code's 'Don't Ask Again' setting exposed 2,539 secrets on GitHub. Claude Meetings, Sheets and Whiteboards were reported just before the roadshow.

providers.name: Google Gemini
providers.headline: No new Gemini release was found in the last 48 hours.
providers.detail: Searches turned up only older Gemini 3 and I/O 2026 coverage, and there is still no confirmed ship date for Gemini 3.5 Pro.

providers.name: xAI
providers.headline: Still no Grok 5; Grok 4.7 (Sept) and Voice 3.0 (Oct 14) are the latest releases.
providers.detail: No November release was found. grok-imagine-image-quality retired on Nov 2.

providers.name: Meta
providers.headline: No new release was found, and the Muse Spark 1.2 weights are still unshipped.
providers.detail: Meta's current lines are Muse Spark (closed) and Muse Glimmer (30B, open-weight, from August). The Llama brand appears dormant.

providers.name: Mistral
providers.headline: No new release since Large 4 on Oct 29.
providers.detail: No November item was found. Large 4 (1T parameters, open-weight) remains the latest flagship.

providers.name: Perplexity
providers.headline: No new release in the last 48 hours; Teammates agents (Nov 5, $200/mo Max only) is still the latest.
providers.detail: Teammates is an always-on agent research preview for Max subscribers on web, with iOS and desktop apps promised. A Comet Assistant upgrade and patent search followed on Nov 6.

providers.name: Microsoft 365 Copilot
providers.headline: Ignite opens Nov 17, and Office-in-Copilot reaches general availability this month.
providers.detail: Word, Excel and PowerPoint inside the Copilot app reach worldwide general availability by mid-November. Autopilot is rolling out to Frontier, with admin controls still TBD. Fair-use limits now apply to Copilot Chat for unlicensed users, and default usage-based billing for CSP has slipped to Q1 2027.

providers.name: GitHub Copilot
providers.headline: No confirmed update was found.
providers.detail: The latest known items are Claude Haiku 5.5, local sandboxing and Ollama support in VS Code Copilot 1.141 (October). Ignite-adjacent announcements are possible this week.

providers.name: Cursor
providers.headline: No new update after the Nov 12 OpenAI cutoff was extended.
providers.detail: OpenAI model access continues past Nov 12 with no new end date, and Anthropic has confirmed it will keep supplying Claude.

providers.name: Gamma
providers.headline: No release in the last 48 hours; Gamma 5 (early Oct) is still current.
providers.detail: Gamma 5 brought agent-built decks and context from more than 20 tools, including Slack and Notion. Workflow tweaks followed on Oct 26.

providers.name: Notion AI
providers.headline: No new release was found.
providers.detail: The last changelog items are from August: Meeting Notes as a Custom Agent trigger, and the grouped model picker.

watch.title: New York AI safety law — registration by January
watch.body: Companies with more than $500M in annual revenue must publish safety frameworks, report critical incidents within 72 hours and file transparency reports. The 72-hour incident clock is relevant to clients' incident-response plans.
